## What's changed

- Added capability-aware AAC 5.1 audio for Apple TV Tube TV sessions when both the current program and configured output support surround sound.
- Kept one stable audio codec and channel layout across programs, commercials, and bumpers so reliable channel transitions are preserved.
- Isolated stereo and surround HLS sessions so stereo-only and retro players retain their existing compatible playback path.
- Added Tube TV audio codec, channel layout, and transcode mode details to active-stream reporting.
- Left local-library, Discovery, Steam, and retro-player playback behavior unchanged.
